tasks_recurrence_due_idx.name: tasks_recurrence_due_idx
tasks_recurrence_due_idx.where: "tasks"."recurrence" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND NOT "tasks"."archived"

time_adjustment_requests_shape.name: time_adjustment_requests_shape
time_adjustment_requests_shape.value: ("time_adjustment_requests"."delta_ms" IS NOT NULL) <> ("time_adjustment_requests"."new_started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "time_adjustment_requests"."new_ended_at" IS NOT NULL)

installments_paid_fields.name: installments_paid_fields
installments_paid_fields.value: "installments"."status" <> 'pago' OR ("installments"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL AND "installments"."paid_amount_cents" IS NOT NULL)
